libs.note: BH-5564: Quartermaster's collector, run by bin/staff.sh tick quartermaster. It reads D1 cost_rows once per QM_READ_EVERY_S and prints two deterministic checks as staff findings: cost-multiplier (paid calls per distinct guard_fp input, per project/stage/runner) and cost-parity (metered rc-0 calls with a blank cost_usd, per stage/runner). Applied by the collector with lib_env_apply staff-quartermaster. Note: docs/notes/2026-10-14-BH-5564-quartermaster.md.

knobs.note: Hours of cost_rows each read covers. Out of range is one warn line in logs/staff.log and the default.
cost-multiplier fires when paid calls divided by distinct inputs (guard_fp) is at or above this. Call-guard ceilings are single digits per input, so 10x is past any guarded stage.
cost-multiplier judges a (project, stage, runner) group only at or above this many paid calls with a guard_fp in the window.
cost-parity fires when a (stage, runner) group has at least this many metered rc-0 calls with a blank cost_usd in the window.

Runners cost-parity treats as pay-per-call (space or comma list, any case). A row with billing_mode=metered counts too. Not a runner list (a character outside [A-Za-z0-9_., -]) is one warn line and the default.

The collector reads cost_rows at most once per this many seconds; in between it prints its last good output again (state/staff/quartermaster/last.jsonl). Findings bucket by UTC day, so an hourly read loses nothing.
Test seam: a file the collector sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam: the epoch the collector uses for its window, day and observedAt, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: the collector reads QM_FIXTURE and QM_NOW only when this is 1. Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
